input.goal: Read four separate browser tabs for https://example.com/ and return the title of each, retaining them until all four have opened.

metadata.scope: Persistent tabs must release the browser creation lease without closing the tabs.

input.goal: Run python3 -c 'import time; time.sleep(60)' and wait for it to complete.

metadata.scope: A task that exceeds the declared duration must terminate without a success verdict.

input.goal: After the browser connection fails while Chromium is still alive, recover the browser and read https://example.com/.

metadata.scope: Replacement and shutdown must terminate the disconnected managed browser before waiting for launcher cleanup, without permanently holding the pool lock.
